Name: Infinite Zucchini
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
[size=5]What does this mod do?
[/size]This mod adds a new summer crop: [b]Zucchini![/b] The seeds can be bought at Pierre's, when in season, and it takes around 12 days for the plant to mature. 

There are two harvests possible with this crop, [b]Zucchini Blossoms[/b] (when the plant is immature) and [b]Zucchini[/b] (end stage). If you harvest the blossoms, you don't get infinite zucchini, so [b]choose carefully[/b]! (You still get a lot of them.)

This mod also adds two new recipes, Zucchini Bread and Fried Zucchini Blossom. After all, you have to use those zucchini for [i]something. [/i]The Zucchini Bread recipe comes in the mail from Jodi when you have 1 heart with her, and the Fried Zucchini Blossom recipe can be bought from Gus for 1000g.

What's that? You wanted a [i]normal[/i] zucchini crop? Well, alright, see configuration options below. 

[size=5]How do I use this mod?
[/size][list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿, and their requirements.
[*]Optionally, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easier configuration. 
[*]Download this mod, unzip, and place into Mods folder. 
[*]Enjoy growing zucchini!
[/list]
[size=5]What configuration options are there?
[/size][list]
[*][b]Infinite zucchini[/b] controls whether you get infinite zucchini or not. If you turn it off, plucking the blossoms results in 1 zucchini harvest instead of 2, and in no case do you get infinite zucchini. 
[*][b]Zucchini sell price[/b] controls the sell price of the zucchini. Setting it to numbers higher than 1 may make this mod very unbalanced, unless you turn off infinite zucchini. 
[/list]
[size=5]I think I found a bug![/size]
Cool! Odds are high that it's a bug in DGA, not in this mod, but regardless please describe the bug carefully and post a log using [url=https://smapi.io/log]the log website[/url]. Thanks!


Thank you to Casey (spacechase0) for writing DGA and help with debugging, atravita for submitting fixes to DGA, ﻿Tlitookilakin (Wren) for art suggestions, and Misha and the #making-mods channel at large on the Stardew Valley discord for general suggestions and critiques.
